method: 48 Cycles-lit views per sewn garment; lossless 12-bit UV maps and separate neutral diffuse/specular lighting, dynamically recoloured in linear space

jersey.changes: Isolated Jersey, welded mesh, mannequin-supported cloth relaxation, real thickness, open neck and sleeves, stitched boundary piping, new UV atlas and lighting

scarf.source: Original procedural mesh and woven material by SSL
scarf.details: Two readable sides, physical drape and 96 individual fringe strands

logos: Original league and club marks remain unchanged
runtime: Self-hosted calibrated UV material renderer; four views per atlas, bounded image and frame caches. No WebGL required. Not a live cloth simulation.
artwork: Original composition and vector typography, with optional existing locally hosted generated stadium background.
